title: Shuttle feedback-05: synchronous fixture retirement and clean native saves
acceptance_criteria: Certified native position correction is separate from bounded own movement, velocity, animation and carrier application; existing movement limits and floor grounding rules remain unchanged.
All four exterior wall faces, supported strong cargo, passive/active bodies, moving/falling reconnect, airlock safety and finite cabin ventilation pass their native regression fixtures.
The current source compiles and passes fresh full JUnit and unfiltered native GameTests without changing owner configuration or launching a client.
Serialization diagnostics preserve the original operation/result/exception and identify a failing owner without suppressing saves or changing physics lifecycle.
Fixture close synchronously retires only its exact registered owner, preserving gas archives and replacements; combined and full native runs save/shut down without removed-owner exceptions.
manual_steps: Review the source-only gate evidence and unresolved boundaries. Private packaging and connected retesting remain on hold; no client launch or installation is requested.

Only after explicit authorization and identification of the installed artifact: walk diagonally and jump against each cabin wall, then check Creative/logout and falling-cabin rejoin preserve the same body, Mind and items.
